{"status":"ok","dna":{"schemaVersion":3,"id":"ai-mwxnrzl7-71a","name":"明るさ自動スイッチ玄関灯","purpose":"玄関の壁に付け、周りが暗くなると自動で足元を照らし、明るくなると自動で消える灯り。","overview":"玄関の壁に付けておくと、日が暮れて暗くなれば自動で足元を照らし、朝明るくなれば自動で消える灯りです。","tags":["lighting","daily","outdoor"],"mount":"fixed","appearance":"graphite","mode":"dream","parts":[{"id":"base","type":"body","shape":"box","material":"aluminum","position":[0,0,0],"scale":[0.12,0.16,0.08],"role":"センサーと発光部を支える灯りの本体"},{"id":"wall-plate","type":"panel","shape":"box","material":"plastic","position":[0,0,-0.0425],"scale":[0.16,0.24,0.01],"role":"玄関の壁に本体を取り付ける板"},{"id":"lamp","type":"light","shape":"cylinder","material":"glass","position":[0,-0.095,0],"scale":[0.1,0.04,0.1],"role":"下向きに光を出して足元を照らす"},{"id":"eye","type":"sensor","shape":"sphere","material":"plastic","position":[0,0.05,0.0475],"scale":[0.025,0.025,0.025],"role":"周りの明るさを測り点灯・消灯を決める"}],"behaviors":[{"type":"illuminate","targetPart":"lamp","parameters":{"lumens":400,"beamAngleDeg":100,"tiltDeg":60}}],"functionMap":[{"need":"暗くなったら自動で点く","blocks":["illuminate"],"status":"simplified","note":"暗さは一定の明るさの環境として再現し、プログラムが点灯させた結果の足元の照度だけを測ります。夕方に徐々に暗くなる変化は再現しません。","how":"センサーが周りが30lxより暗いと判断すると、発光部が光り始める。"},{"need":"明るくなったら自動で消える","blocks":["illuminate"],"status":"demonstrated","note":"プログラムで消える動きは見せられますが、消えたことを測る指標はありません。","how":"センサーが80lxより明るいと判断すると、発光部の光を消す。"},{"need":"玄関の足元を十分に照らす","blocks":["illuminate"],"status":"simulated","how":"発光部が400lmの光を下向き60°に広げ、玄関の足元を照らす。"},{"need":"屋外の雨や汚れに耐える","blocks":[],"status":"unverifiable","note":"防水性や耐久性を確かめる仕組みはこのラボにありません。","how":"防水の覆いや丈夫な素材が必要ですが、このラボでは試せません。"}],"program":{"version":1,"flags":[],"rules":[{"id":"light_on","label":"暗いあいだは灯りを点ける","trigger":"while","cooldown":0,"when":{"all":[{"sensor":"ambient_light","op":"<","value":30}]},"do":[{"action":"set_behavior","behavior":"illuminate","on":true}]},{"id":"light_off","label":"明るいあいだは灯りを消す","trigger":"while","cooldown":0,"when":{"all":[{"sensor":"ambient_light","op":">","value":80}]},"do":[{"action":"set_behavior","behavior":"illuminate","on":false}]}]},"constraints":{"maxParts":24,"maxSpeed":3},"revision":1,"parentRevision":null},"designPoints":["点く明るさと消える明るさに差をつけ、境目で点滅しにくくしました。","発光部を本体の下に付け、まぶしくなく足元を照らす向きにしました。","センサーを正面上に出し、灯り自身の光を拾いにくい位置にしました。"],"plans":[{"title":"夜の玄関の足元照度","aim":"暗い玄関で自動点灯した灯りが足元を十分に照らせるか確かめる。","plan":{"scenario":"stand","mode":"dream","durationSec":10,"seed":1234,"modules":[{"type":"darkness","lux":2}],"metrics":["footIlluminance","illuminanceMin"],"criteria":[{"metric":"footIlluminance","op":">=","value":10,"reason":"夜に足元の段差が見える明るさ（目安）"},{"metric":"illuminanceMin","op":">=","value":3,"reason":"照らす範囲の端でも真っ暗にならない（目安）"}]}},{"title":"夜の灯りの電力と重さ","aim":"点けっぱなしの夜でも電力と重さが玄関灯として現実的か確かめる。","plan":{"scenario":"stand","mode":"reality","durationSec":10,"seed":1234,"modules":[{"type":"darkness","lux":2}],"metrics":["blockPowerW","totalMassKg","footIlluminance"],"criteria":[{"metric":"blockPowerW","op":"<=","value":20,"reason":"一晩中点けても電気代が小さい範囲（目安）"},{"metric":"totalMassKg","op":"<=","value":3,"reason":"壁に取り付けられる重さ（目安）"}]}}],"fixes":[],"message":"周りの明るさを測るセンサーで、暗いと点灯・明るいと消灯する玄関灯を設計しました。","model":"claude-opus-5-5","usage":{"input":56,"output":3136,"cacheRead":15119,"cacheWrite":0,"ms":28914,"costUsd":0.06596780000000001}}

{"status":"ok","dna":{"schemaVersion":3,"id":"ai-mwxnstfy-pdw","name":"雨で自動展開する窓ひさし","purpose":"雨が当たったことをセンサーで感じ取り、たたんでいたひさしをモーターで下ろして窓の前を雨から守る。","overview":"窓の上の壁に付け、晴れの日はたたんでおき、雨が降り出すと自動でひさしを下ろして窓を守る道具。","tags":["protection","daily","sensing"],"mount":"fixed","appearance":"lab_white","mode":"dream","parts":[{"id":"housing","type":"body","shape":"box","material":"aluminum","position":[0,0,0],"scale":[1,0.12,0.15],"role":"壁に固定し、ひさしとモーターを支える"},{"id":"awning","type":"canopy","shape":"box","material":"plastic","position":[0,-0.05,0.52],"scale":[1,0.02,0.9],"role":"下りて窓の前の雨をさえぎる板","joint":{"type":"hinge","parent":"housing","axis":"x","pivot":[0,0,-0.45],"min":-90,"max":0,"speed":45,"home":-85}},{"id":"hinge-motor","type":"motor","shape":"cylinder","material":"steel","position":[0.42,0,0],"scale":[0.06,0.06,0.06],"role":"ひさしを回してたたむ・下ろす"},{"id":"rain-eye","type":"sensor","shape":"sphere","material":"glass","position":[0,0.075,0],"scale":[0.04,0.04,0.04],"role":"雨粒が当たったことを感じ取る"}],"behaviors":[{"type":"rain_shield","targetPart":"awning","parameters":{"radius":0.5,"effectiveness":0.9,"skirtLength":0.1}}],"functionMap":[{"need":"窓の前を雨から守る","blocks":["rain_shield"],"status":"simplified","note":"窓そのものは無いため、ひさしの下に立つ人型モデルの濡れ方で代わりに評価する。","how":"下ろしたひさしが雨をさえぎり、端の垂れ部分が横からの雨も防ぐ。"},{"need":"雨が降ったら自動で閉じる","blocks":[],"status":"demonstrated","note":"雨センサーをきっかけにひさしが動く様子をプログラムで見せる。動く速さや確実さを測る指標はない。","how":"センサーが雨を感じるとモーターがひさしを水平まで下ろす。"},{"need":"雨がやんだら元に戻る","blocks":[],"status":"demonstrated","note":"雨が当たらなくなってしばらくするとたたむ動きをプログラムで見せるだけで、数値では測らない。","how":"雨が当たらなくなって10秒たつとモーターがひさしを立ててたたむ。"},{"need":"防水性・耐久性","blocks":[],"status":"unverifiable","note":"モーターや継ぎ目の防水、長年の風雨への強さはこのラボのモデルでは試せない。","how":"防水の工夫や耐久試験が必要だが、このラボでは試せない。"}],"program":{"version":1,"flags":[],"rules":[{"id":"close_on_rain","label":"雨が当たったらひさしを下ろす","trigger":"rise","cooldown":1,"when":{"all":[{"sensor":"rain","is":true}]},"do":[{"action":"move_joint","joint":"awning","target":0,"speed":45}]},{"id":"stow_after_rain","label":"雨がやんだら少し待ってたたむ","trigger":"rise","cooldown":5,"when":{"all":[{"sensor":"rain","is":false}]},"do":[{"action":"wait","seconds":10},{"action":"move_joint","joint":"awning","target":-85,"speed":30}]}]},"constraints":{"maxParts":24,"maxSpeed":3},"revision":1,"parentRevision":null},"designPoints":["雨センサーは本体の上に置き、最初の雨粒を受けやすくした。","ひさしは奥側を軸に回すので、たたむと壁に沿って邪魔にならない。","雨がやんですぐ戻らないよう、少し待ってからたたむようにした。"],"plans":[{"title":"にわか雨の防護テスト","aim":"ひさしが下りたとき、その下をどれだけ雨から守れるかを確かめる。","plan":{"scenario":"stand","mode":"dream","durationSec":30,"seed":1234,"modules":[{"type":"rain","intensity":20},{"type":"wind","speed":3,"directionDeg":90}],"metrics":["wetnessScore","coverageRatio"],"criteria":[{"metric":"coverageRatio","op":">=","value":0.7,"reason":"ひさしの下の7割以上を雨から守れれば窓の保護に役立つ（目安）"}]}}],"fixes":[],"message":"雨を感知するとひさしを下ろして窓の前を覆う、壁取り付け型の自動ひさしを設計しました。","model":"claude-opus-5-5","usage":{"input":50,"output":3741,"cacheRead":15119,"cacheWrite":0,"ms":38684,"costUsd":0.0780438}}

{"status":"ok","dna":{"schemaVersion":3,"id":"ai-mwxnpej7-cw7","name":"ハンズフリー頭上傘","purpose":"頭に付けたベルトから支柱で傘を頭上に保ち、両手を使わずに雨を防ぐ。","overview":"雨の日に荷物やスマホで手がふさがる人が、頭に付けるだけで傘の代わりに使える雨よけです。","tags":["protection","outdoor","daily"],"mount":"head","appearance":"safety_orange","mode":"dream","parts":[{"id":"hub","type":"body","shape":"cylinder","material":"plastic","position":[0,0,0],"scale":[0.12,0.05,0.12],"role":"支柱と頭のベルトをつなぐ土台"},{"id":"band","type":"strap","shape":"box","material":"fabric","position":[0,-0.04,0],"scale":[0.2,0.03,0.22],"role":"頭に巻いて道具全体を固定する"},{"id":"mast","type":"frame","shape":"cylinder","material":"aluminum","position":[0,0.12,0],"scale":[0.02,0.2,0.02],"role":"傘を頭より上の高さに持ち上げる"},{"id":"canopy","type":"canopy","shape":"dome","material":"fabric","position":[0,0.13,0],"scale":[1.1,0.2,1.1],"role":"頭と肩の上を覆って雨を受け止める"}],"behaviors":[{"type":"follow_head","targetPart":"canopy","parameters":{"heightOffset":0.35}},{"type":"rain_shield","targetPart":"canopy","parameters":{"radius":0.55,"effectiveness":0.9,"skirtLength":0.2}},{"type":"stabilize","targetPart":"hub","parameters":{"stabilizationStrength":0.5}}],"functionMap":[{"need":"両手を使わずに雨を防ぐ","blocks":["follow_head","rain_shield"],"status":"simulated","how":"頭のベルトで固定した傘が頭上についていき、雨を受け止めます。"},{"need":"風のある雨でも濡れにくい","blocks":["rain_shield","stabilize"],"status":"simplified","note":"風は雨粒を斜めにする効果だけで表し、傘があおられる力は扱わない。","how":"傘のふちの側面カバーと姿勢を保つ働きで、斜めの雨も防ぎます。"},{"need":"頭に乗せても重すぎない","blocks":["follow_head"],"status":"simplified","note":"部品の大きさと材料から推定した重さを、頭の目安と比べるだけ。","how":"傘を軽い布、支柱を細いアルミにして重さを抑えています。"},{"need":"防水性とつけ心地","blocks":[],"status":"unverifiable","note":"布の防水性能や頭への当たり心地はこのラボでは試せない。","how":"防水布や柔らかいベルトが必要ですが、このラボでは試せません。"}],"constraints":{"maxParts":24,"maxSpeed":3},"revision":1,"parentRevision":null},"designPoints":["傘の直径を約1.1mにして肩まで覆えるようにした。","ふちに20cmの側面カバーを付け、風で斜めに降る雨に備えた。","頭への負担を減らすため、傘は布、支柱は細いアルミにした。"],"plans":[{"title":"ふつうの雨での防護テスト","aim":"両手を使わずに体が雨から守られるかを確かめる。","plan":{"scenario":"stand","mode":"dream","durationSec":20,"seed":1234,"modules":[{"type":"rain","intensity":30},{"type":"wind","speed":2}],"metrics":["wetnessScore","coverageRatio"],"criteria":[{"metric":"coverageRatio","op":">=","value":0.8,"reason":"体の8割以上を雨から守れれば実用的（目安）"},{"metric":"wetnessScore","op":"<=","value":50,"reason":"当たる雨粒が少なければ合格（目安）"}]}},{"title":"風の強い雨でのテスト","aim":"横風で斜めに降る雨でも濡れにくいかを確かめる。","plan":{"scenario":"stand","mode":"dream","durationSec":20,"seed":1234,"modules":[{"type":"rain","intensity":50},{"type":"wind","speed":8,"directionDeg":90}],"metrics":["wetnessScore","coverageRatio"],"criteria":[{"metric":"coverageRatio","op":">=","value":0.6,"reason":"強風でも6割以上守れれば十分（目安）"}]}},{"title":"重さと電力の現実チェック","aim":"頭に乗せても重すぎないかを確かめる。","plan":{"scenario":"stand","mode":"reality","durationSec":20,"seed":1234,"modules":[{"type":"rain","intensity":20}],"metrics":["totalMassKg","mountLoadRatio","energyWh"],"criteria":[{"metric":"mountLoadRatio","op":"<=","value":1,"reason":"頭に乗せる重さの目安を超えないこと（目安）"},{"metric":"totalMassKg","op":"<=","value":1,"reason":"1kg以下なら長時間付けやすい（目安）"}]}}],"fixes":[],"message":"頭の上に傘を浮かべるように固定し、両手を空けたまま雨を防ぐ頭装着型の雨よけを設計しました。","model":"claude-opus-5-5","usage":{"input":57,"output":3288,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":15119,"ms":32934,"costUsd":0.141583}}

{"status":"ok","dna":{"schemaVersion":3,"id":"ai-mwxnpfrn-lr0","name":"ついてくる日陰ドーム","purpose":"夏の通学路で、頭の上に広げたドームが日差しをさえぎり、歩く人に日陰を作る。","overview":"夏の通学中に頭へ着けると、頭上の布ドームが日差しをさえぎり、体に日陰を作る道具です。","tags":["protection","outdoor","daily"],"mount":"head","appearance":"field_green","mode":"dream","parts":[{"id":"base","type":"body","shape":"box","material":"plastic","position":[0,0,0],"scale":[0.18,0.06,0.2],"role":"頭の上で全体を支える土台"},{"id":"band","type":"strap","shape":"ring","material":"fabric","position":[0,-0.04,0],"scale":[0.22,0.03,0.22],"role":"頭に巻いて道具を固定するベルト"},{"id":"pole","type":"frame","shape":"cylinder","material":"aluminum","position":[0,0.19,0],"scale":[0.02,0.33,0.02],"role":"ドームを頭より上に持ち上げる支柱"},{"id":"shade","type":"canopy","shape":"dome","material":"fabric","position":[0,0.35,0],"scale":[1.2,0.18,1.2],"role":"日差しをさえぎり日陰を作る布の覆い"}],"behaviors":[{"type":"sun_shade","targetPart":"shade","parameters":{"radius":0.6,"opacity":0.95}},{"type":"follow_head","targetPart":"shade","parameters":{"heightOffset":0.35}},{"type":"stabilize","targetPart":"base","parameters":{"stabilizationStrength":0.5}}],"functionMap":[{"need":"頭の上に日陰を作る","blocks":["sun_shade"],"status":"simulated","how":"布の覆いが光をさえぎり、頭と体の上に影を落とす。"},{"need":"朝の斜めの日差しも防ぐ","blocks":["sun_shade"],"status":"simulated","how":"直径1.2mの広い覆いで、斜めの光でも体に影がかかるようにする。"},{"need":"歩いても頭上に保つ","blocks":["follow_head","stabilize"],"status":"simplified","note":"立っている人型モデルの頭上に保つ形でのみ確かめ、歩く揺れそのものは試験しない。","how":"覆いを頭上の決まった高さに保ち、土台の姿勢を安定させる。"},{"need":"首が疲れない着け心地","blocks":[],"status":"unverifiable","note":"着け心地や首の疲れは人の感じ方なので試験できない。重さの推定だけは現実モードで見られる。","how":"首への負担は軽い素材で減らす工夫が必要だが、この研究所では試験しない。"}],"constraints":{"maxParts":24,"maxSpeed":3},"revision":1,"parentRevision":null},"designPoints":["覆いは軽い布のドームにして、傘のような形で広く影を作る。","支柱で頭から少し離し、熱がこもりにくい高さに覆いを置く。","部品を4つにしぼり、頭に載せる重さを小さくした。"],"plans":[{"title":"真昼の日陰テスト","aim":"太陽が高い真昼に、頭上の覆いが体に日陰を作れるかを確かめる。","plan":{"scenario":"stand","mode":"dream","durationSec":10,"seed":1234,"modules":[{"type":"sunlight
